dedupe_keys.name: mairie des ponts de ce road datasets

description: MAIRIE DES PONTS DE CE: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MAIRIE DES PONTS DE CE. Coverage: MAIRIE DES PONTS DE CE. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Construction d’un espace jeunes Avenue Gallieni aux Ponts de Cé; RENOVATION DE LA SALLE VAL DE LOUET - LES PONTS DE CE; Prestations techniques son et lumière pour le festival les TRAVER’CE m; SERVICES D'ASSURANCES POUR LE GROUPEMENT DE COMMANDE CONSTITUE ENTRE L. Formats seen: PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
